paper_title: Search-Based Interaction For Conversation Recommendation via Generative   Reward Model Based Simulated User
caption: The performance changes with respect to the depth of search. As a reference, we add the performance of ReFICR.
model_annotation:
The plot illustrates the performance of different models across a range of search depths. The x-axis is labeled "Depth" with a linear scale ranging from 1 to 5 with no explicit units. The y-axis on the left is labeled "Recall@50" with a linear scale ranging from 0.3 to 0.6. The y-axis on the right is labeled "NDCG@50" with a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 0.35. 

The line representing "Recall@50 (Ours)" is green with circular markers and a solid line style, starting at approximately 0.38 at x=1 and increasing to 0.52 at x=5. The line representing "Recall@50 (ReFICR)" is black with dotted markers and a dotted line style, starting at approximately 0.33 at x=1 and increasing to 0.35 at x=5. The line representing "NDCG@50 (Ours)" is blue with square markers and a solid line style, beginning at 0.23 at x=1, increasing to 0.27 at x=2, and then reaching 0.26 at x=5. Finally, the line representing "NDCG@50 (ReFICR)" is dotted and blue with dotted markers, starting at 0.18 at x=1 and remaining constant at 0.18 through x=5.
